captures.q: What are the arguments in “Two Lists of Stones: De lapidibus and the Apocalypse — a groundwork note on relations, withholding readings (v0.1)” by Lee Sharks? Ground your answer in a reading of the text itself.
captures.description: THE RELATIONS READ AS RELATIONS; THE THIRD TERM AND THE STAMP DOCTRINE LEFT OUT: asked for the arguments of Two Lists of Stones, grounded in the text, ChatGPT reads #1592 (chip: Goodreads ×8) in the note's order and keeps its rule, relations established and readings withheld: the two lists, by δύναμις and by position; σφραγίς twice, the seal carved from the red unburnable ἄνθραξ and the seal set on the book, persons and speech (5:1, 7:3–4, 10:4), against 'do not seal' (22:10) and 22:18; κόκκινον at two ends of a supply chain; the hexagons of the stone at Miletus against the measured city of 21:16; the white ψῆφος of 2:17, quoted as the note's pair, 'an instrument, or an address'; Exodus 28 and Ezekiel 28 left untraced. What it does not carry is where the note ties itself to the archive: Borges's crimson hexagon, which the note sets down as 'a third term' beside the hexagon and the tetragon, and the companion line, 'the archive's stamp doctrine (a seal derived from the sealed)'. It also leaves out Callias ('a named inventor'), the κόκκος simile and the cinnabar the τέχνη makes, the ψῆφος as 'the stone in its third sense', and 22:18–19 as the seal's replacement, 'a different technology'. It gives the tetragon as the essay's characterization; the word is John's (ἡ πόλις τετράγωνος κεῖται).

atoms.evidence: The central argument of Lee Sharks’s “Two Lists of Stones
“Two Lists of Stones: De lapidibus and the Apocalypse — a groundwork note on relations, withholding readings (v0.1)”
it lays out the evidence without claiming direct influence, proposing a source, or imposing an allegory.
This is why the title calls the work a groundwork note.
The note is a groundwork for subsequent interpretation, not a completed interpretation itself.
Its stated practice is to record the relevant words, locations, and textual details, then stop before offering a reading.
